nodes.name: On Workflow Error
nodes.notes: Global error trigger for CASE 2 only. Fires when 00 / 01 / 02 / 03r / 03 / 04 (each naming this workflow as its Error Workflow) throws an UNHANDLED error. Case 1 keeps its own handler (8lWcGsY178OA0ePk) - the two are deliberately separate so this repo ships standalone.

nodes.name: Build Error Report
nodes.notes: Parses the Error Trigger payload into a run_logs 'failed' row (cart_id null - see comment) plus a #automation-errors Block Kit alert. metadata.case = 'case-2' so one shared run_logs table stays queryable per project.

nodes.name: Log Failure To Supabase
nodes.notes: Persists the crash to run_logs (status=failed). Continue-On-Fail + neverError so a Supabase blip never stops the Slack alert - the alert is the part a human actually sees.

nodes.name: Alert Errors Channel
nodes.notes: Immediate crash alert to #automation-errors via chat.postMessage (bot token). 4 tries / 3s / 15s timeout - same hardening as every other Slack call in this build, against intermittent egress resets.

parameters.content:
## 99 - Global Error Handler (Case 2)
Fires ONLY on an UNHANDLED crash in `00`, `01`, `02`, `03r`, `03`, `04` - each names this workflow as its Error Workflow. Writes a `run_logs` row (status=failed, metadata.case=case-2) and alerts #automation-errors.

**What does NOT reach here, by design:** Shopify / Anthropic / Twilio / Supabase / Slack failures inside the main flows are all Continue-On-Fail. They degrade gracefully, write their own `run_logs` row (`conversion_check_failed`, `twilio_send_failed`, `touch_deferred_send_window`...), and are surfaced by **`02`'s sweep-summary alert** and the **`05` daily digest** - not by a crash alert.

Case 1 keeps its own handler (`8lWcGsY178OA0ePk`). Two handlers, not one, so this case study ships as a standalone repo.
